capabilities: Build a virtual folder tree from nested tags
Show files in multiple virtual folders at once
Drag and drop files to assign or move tags
Document folders via metadata files and color-code entries
extras: README warns the plugin is under development and recommends backing up the vault; installation is manual only (no Community Plugins marketplace listing in the README), and it documents detailed performance optimizations.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's default tag explorer view is quite basic and doesnt build on the potential of this feature.
motivation: The author wanted a balance between dumping files in one chronological folder and burying them in deep project folders where they get forgotten.
problem: Obsidian's default tag explorer is basic and real folders lock each file into a single directory, so multi-path organization is not natively possible.
summary: Tag-based file explorer that turns Obsidian's nested tags into virtual folder trees where files can appear in multiple locations.
